annotations.title: Per-creative performance inside TikTok Smart+ ads

description: HOW EACH CREATIVE PERFORMS INSIDE TIKTOK UPGRADED SMART+ ADS, from TikTok's Smart+ creative report: one row per video, image, carousel or Spark post (by main_material_id; a Spark post's row carries its TikTok post id as tiktokItemId), or per ad text, call to action or add-on (by). view overview (default): totals over startDate..endDate or lifetime:true, grouped by the ad (or the campaign / ad group you filter on), with each creative's status. view breakdown: the same over time (timeGrain hour, day, week, month or none; dates required). Filter with ONE of campaignIds, adGroupIds or smartPlusAdIds (up to 200), and optionally materialTypes. Default metrics spend, impressions, clicks, ctr, cpc, cpm, conversion, cost_per_conversion, or name TikTok's metric names. Money is in the ad account currency; dates are the account's time zone, at most 365 days. Zero rows means nothing delivered in that window, never 'no creatives'. Read-only, free.

advertiserId.description: TikTok advertiser id; omit when the connection has one

groupBy.description: overview: advertiser_id, campaign_id, adgroup_id or smart_plus_ad_id (default: the level you filter on, else the ad)

lifetime.description: overview: lifetime totals instead of dates

materialIds.description: only these creatives (needs exactly one materialTypes)

timeGrain.description: breakdown: hour, day (default), week, month or none

name: tiktok_smart_material_report
title: Per-creative performance inside TikTok Smart+ ads
